title: Let an agent see the callers camera
alias: ai.params enable_vision + vision_model + a get_visual_input filler
summary: enable_vision true in ai.params lets the agent read the caller's camera through the platform's get_visual_input function. vision_model picks the model, and an internal filler for get_visual_input covers the look.
scenario: A workshop desk on a video call that wants to see the worn part before it gives advice

evidence: schema.json AIParams enable_vision (names get_visual_input), vision_model consts gpt-4o-mini|gpt-4.1-mini|gpt-4.1-nano
schema.json SWAIGInternalFiller includes get_visual_input; SWAIGNativeFunction does not
